title: Search tag text
what: Filters tags by text, ignoring case and Vietnamese accents. On To do / Pinned tags this box searches every group; with a group open, it searches that group. On phones tap the magnifier to open the box.

how.t: Click "To do" in the sidebar to get a message list
Click the search box at the top of the page ("Search all groups…", or press /) and type keywords
how.at: Tìm tin tag ở mọi nhóm

how.t: Click the X "Clear search" (or press Esc) to clear it

keys: search find tags text shortcut / filter

title: Filter by date range
what: Shows only tags within the chosen dates (the last 7 days by default; pick "All" to see every stored tag); applies to the group list, counts and message lists.

how.t: Click "To do" in the sidebar to get a message list
Click the calendar button "Pick the date range of tagged messages"
Pick a preset, e.g. "Last 7 days" (or enter "From" / "To", then click "Done")
Click the X "Clear date filter" to remove the filter

keys: date range filter dates calendar today yesterday 7 days 30 days this month from to

title: Open / Handled / Whole group
what: Switches between unhandled tags, handled tags, and Whole group: every other message in the group read live from Telegram (not saved; tags are not repeated there, they stay in the unhandled / handled views). Snoozing a message in Whole group saves it as a tag, back in the unhandled view when the time comes. "Mark all done" is hidden while a sender filter or a search is on, since it marks the whole group.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Done" to see handled tags
Click "Whole group" to read every message live from Telegram (when nothing is left unhandled there is a "See every message in the group" button)

keys: unhandled handled whole group message filter view live all messages

title: Filter by sender
what: Shows only one sender's messages among those loaded. The filter appears only when the group has 2 or more senders.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Whole group" to get several senders (the filter appears only with 2 or more)
Pick a person in the "All senders" box; pick "All senders" again to clear the filter

keys: filter by sender sender filter all senders

title: Search within a group
what: Searches the saved messages of the open group, using the search box at the top of the page.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Type in the search box at the top of the page ("Search this group…"; key /). On To do this box searches every group
how.at: Tìm tin tag trong nhóm này

how.t: Click the X "Clear search" (or Esc) to stop searching

keys: search in group find saved messages magnifier

title: Mark everything as handled
what: Moves every unhandled message in the group (within the filtered dates) to Handled, like clicking Done on each one (no reaction): Q&A threads with a #QA… code in those messages and AI Agent sessions started on them (and their attached messages) are done too. Tags left to the Q&A page (not shown in the list) are skipped and stay open there.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Mark all done" (on the "Open" tab)
Confirm "Mark all done" in the "Mark all as done?" box

keys: all done mark all handled mark everything done

title: Load older messages and jump to the latest
what: Loads another page of older messages at the top of the list; when you scroll far up, a round button takes you back down to the latest message. Messages are grouped by day with a sticky date label.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Scroll to the top of the list and click "Load older messages"

how: Scroll up more than a screen away from the latest message: a round down-arrow button appears at the bottom right

how.t: Click the down-arrow button "Jump to the newest message"

keys: load older messages jump to latest scroll bottom date label

title: Group summary (Digest)
what: The AI sums up the group's conversation: To confirm, Settled, Changes, Team impact, To-dos and Topics; read live from Telegram, regardless of tags; messages from senders in Settings › Telegram › Always ignore are left out. Busy groups (up to 2,000 messages at a time) are read in several passes and merged. To confirm / To-dos nobody resolved carry over to the next summary (labeled "open since …") until a new message answers / completes them, so nothing slips. For a group already in Briefing, the "Summary" button opens that group's Briefing (the summary continues from the last one); to see details or summarize another range, use the "Open" button next to the group in Briefing. Summaries of a custom range or of selected messages are for viewing only and do not replace the one in Briefing.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Summary" at the top of the group page (group already in Briefing: click "Open" next to the group in Briefing)
Pick a range: "Since last", "24h", "3 days", "7 days" or "Custom dates"
Click "Summarize N messages"

how: Wait for the AI summary: To confirm, Settled, Changes, Team impact, To-dos, Topics

how.t: Click the "Back to group" arrow to return

keys: digest group summary needs confirmation decided changes team impact to-dos topics conversation open since last time many messages 2000 passes nothing missed

title: Allow / revoke AI access to a group
what: Before summarizing, you must allow the AI to read the group's messages for 7, 30 or 90 days; you can revoke it at any time (revoking deletes the saved summary).

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Summary" at the top of the group page
Pick 7 / 30 / 90 days in the "Allow for" box
Click "Allow"
To revoke, click "Revoke" on the line "AI may read this group until…"

keys: allow ai read group consent permission revoke 30 days

title: Summarize only some messages
what: Summarizes only the selected messages instead of the whole time range; the "Summarized up to here" line shows which messages were in the last run.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Summary" at the top of the group page
In the "Conversation" column, click a message or its checkbox to select / deselect it

how: Hold Shift and click another message to select the whole run between them; the "Summarized up to here" line marks the previous run

how.t: Click "Summarize N selected messages"
how.at: Tóm tắt N tin đã chọn

how.t: Click "Deselect" to clear the selection

keys: select messages shift click range summarize part deselect

title: Use the summary
what: Click a #message number to jump to the original message; YouTrack ticket chips show their state on hover; decisions about a ticket can be posted as a comment; changes to a ticket in the sprint get a scope-change warning; copy everything as Markdown.

how.t: Click a group in the sidebar
Click "Summary" at the top of the group page
Click "Summarize N messages" if there is no summary yet

how: Wait for the result; hover a YouTrack ticket chip to see its state (tickets in the sprint get a scope-change warning)

how.t: Click "#123" next to an item to jump to the original message
Under Settled, click "post to <ticket>" to add a comment on YouTrack
Click "Copy markdown" to copy the summary

keys: copy markdown post to ticket comment scope change sprint original message summary result
